select u.user_id, u.user_name, (u.phone_bound_time is not null) as phone_bound, u.phone_masked, u.status, u.create_time, u.update_time, (select count(1) from house_users hu join rabbit_houses h on h.id = hu.house_id and h.is_deleted = false where hu.user_id = u.user_id and hu.status = 'ENABLED') as house_count from sys_user u
order by u.create_time desc, u.user_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select u.user_id, u.user_name, (u.phone_bound_time is not null) as phone_bound, u.phone_masked, u.status, u.create_time, u.update_time, (select count(1) from house_users hu join rabbit_houses h on h.id = hu.house_id and h.is_deleted = false where hu.user_id = u.user_id and hu.status = 'ENABLED') as house_count from sys_user u where u.user_id = #{userId}

select h.id from rabbit_houses h join house_users hu on hu.house_id = h.id and hu.user_id = #{userId} and hu.role = 'OWNER' and hu.status = 'ENABLED' where h.is_deleted = false order by h.id for update

select count(1) from rabbit_houses h join house_users target on target.house_id = h.id and target.user_id = #{userId} and target.role = 'OWNER' and target.status = 'ENABLED' where h.is_deleted = false and not exists ( select 1 from house_users other join sys_user other_user on other_user.user_id = other.user_id and other_user.status = 'ENABLED' where other.house_id = h.id and other.user_id != #{userId} and other.role = 'OWNER' and other.status = 'ENABLED' )
